title: CPU fallback crashes with "RuntimeError: memory access out of bounds"
body:
On an old laptop without WebGPU the app falls back to the CPU (WebAssembly). Loading Qwen3 0.6B finishes, but the first message fails and the console shows:

```
worker.ts: RuntimeError: memory access out of bounds
    at ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm
```

Chrome 141, Windows 10, Intel i5-7200U, 8 GB RAM.
author: philippmossier
